answer: Each epoch, plant canary answers — flawed texts dressed as a sonnet — among genuine submissions. An attester must read each one to separate a live ember of real work from a planted dud; rubber-stamping everything exposes the attester, and repeated exposure burns its stake and voids its past attestations. A sybil fleet cannot shortcut the canyon of review: every extra clone must do genuine evaluation or risk being caught, so approval cost grows per head instead of splitting.
